Recurring importance of Representation does not imply every historical trajectory instantiates S1; anti-cases can reveal classifier overreach without falsifying the underlying structure.
Conditional operator policy means condition/regime dependence, not perpetual switching; a fixed specialized method can be optimal inside a stable world.
Scale-up can create a new research frontier rather than merely implementation work.
Evidence quality and evaluator interpretation have separable histories; durable observations can outlive the world model that first interpreted them.
World action admissibility and historical epistemic cleanliness are distinct; capability manifests constrain actions but cannot erase pretrained future knowledge.
Required function call, syntactically valid JSON, schema-conformant structured evidence, and semantically readable research decision are distinct states.
